sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Argante is a British heroine or goddess. She is the queen of the Otherworld island of Avalon. Writers describe her as a form of Arianrhod or of Morgan Le Fay. The wounded King Arthur was taken to her realm to heal. He has not yet returned from it.
